title: Vixl document (project.json)
description: The JSON member project.json of a .vixl archive (a ZIP file). Other members are the binary assets it references: assets/<sha256>.<ext>, masks/<sha256>.<ext>, fonts/<sha256>.<ext>, sources/<sha256>.<ext>, emoji-sources/<sha256>.<ext>. See docs/file-format.md.

format_version.description: Archive format version; Vixl writes 2 and reads 1 and 2.

vixl_version.description: Vixl release that saved the file.

state.description: The current document state (the history head).

nodes.description: History revisions by ID (a DAG; branches share ancestors).

redo_stack.description: Revision IDs undo stepped back over, newest last.

transaction.description: An open transaction {state, operations} or null.

asset_hashes.description: SHA-256 of every other archive member; the archive holds exactly these members.

state.description: A document state: the canvas, its layers and every document-level resource.

canvas.description: Canvas size, background and print settings.

size.description: Named size the canvas was made from (vixl sizes).

bleed.description: Bleed in (whole or half) pixels on each side.

safe.description: Safe-area inset in pixels (one number or per side).

physical.description: Physical trim size {width, height, unit, bleed}.

layers.description: Layers bottom to top (of the active page in a paged document).

active_layer.description: ID of the active layer, or null.

selection.description: The pixel selection mask (masks/<sha256>.png), or null.

pages.description: Pages of a multi-page document; the active page's content lives at the top level.

fonts.description: Registered fonts: name → fonts/<sha256>.<ext> archive member.

font_fallbacks.description: Fallback font members tried for missing glyphs.

palettes.description: Named palettes: name → list of colours.

active_palette.description: Name of the palette applied last.

palette_roles.description: Colour roles assigned from the active palette.

symbols.description: Symbol masters: name → master layer ID.

emoji_artwork.description: Emoji artwork record of an emoji document.

design_defaults.description: Design defaults the document was created with (rolled house style).

style.description: Design style tag and its check options.

guides.description: Ruler guides by name: {axis, position, grid or generated}.

layout.description: The layout template applied and its slots.

template.description: Template record of a document made from a template.

artboards.description: Artboards: name → {x, y, width, height, background, variables, targets}.

comps.description: Layer comps: saved visibility and position states.

flows.description: Text flows threading text through several layers.

roles.description: Named layer roles bound for actions and recipes.

snap_to_pixel.description: Round every layer's drawn position to whole pixels.

suites.description: Check suites: named sets of rules (suite-set).

merge.description: Merge-impose record of a generated sheet.

timeline.description: Keyframe timeline: duration, fps, tracks, markers.

lyric_build.description: Options and sources a lyric video document was built from.

deck_markdown.description: Markdown source a deck was built from.

layer.description: One layer. Fields beyond the common ones depend on the type and on the features used.

id.description: Stable layer ID (lyr_ + 16 hex digits); unique in the document and never reused.

name.description: Unique, non-empty layer name; operations address a layer by ID or name.

type.description: Layer type; see the type list.

width.description: Width in pixels (in the parent group's content pixels for a child layer).

x.description: Left edge of the unrotated box, in canvas pixels (parent content pixels for a child layer).

y.description: Top edge of the unrotated box.

rotation.description: Clockwise rotation in degrees around the pivot (default the box centre).

blend.description: Blend mode with what is beneath.

effects.description: Effect stack, applied in order in the layer's own frame before flip, rotation and skew.

mask.description: Raster mask {asset: masks/<sha256>.png, enabled} or null.

constraints.description: Layout constraints: anchor → pixels or an expression over other layers.

parent.description: ID of the group (or other container) that holds this layer; absent or null at the top level.

content_width.description: group: width of the coordinate space its children are laid out in.

content_height.description: group: height of the coordinate space its children are laid out in.

pivot.description: Rotation and scale origin as [x, y] fractions of the box (default [0.5, 0.5]).

skew_x.description: Horizontal skew in degrees (-90 to 90 exclusive).

skew_y.description: Vertical skew in degrees (-90 to 90 exclusive).

affine.description: An exact 2×3 placement matrix for free transforms that x/y/rotation/skew cannot express.

snap_to_pixel.description: Round the drawn position to whole pixels.

clip.description: ID of the layer whose alpha clips this one.

auto_size.description: text: the box follows the text (true) or the text wraps in a fixed box (false).

text_layout.description: text: the fixed box {width, height} text wraps in, and how it fits.

role.description: Layout role: content, decoration, background or title.

tags.description: Free-form tags (selectors, adapt rules such as optional).

stack.description: Auto-layout stack settings of a group: direction, gap, alignment, padding.

hide_if_empty.description: Skip the layer (and its stack slot) while its text is empty after variables.

repeat.description: Repeat settings: count and per-copy offsets (dx, dy, dw, dh, rotation, colour ramp).

symbol.description: symbol: name of the symbol master in state.symbols it instances.

linked.description: raster: the asset is a link to a file outside the archive (allow_linked).

asset_variable.description: Variable naming the image asset to draw (variable data merge).

container.description: Container record of a template slot group.

container_layout.description: Layout a container computed for its contents.

container_variable.description: Variable a container slot is bound to.

container_font_size.description: Font size a container fitted its text to.

image_slot.description: An image slot of a container: fit and focus of the image it holds.

provenance.description: Where the layer came from (import, AI provider, SVG appearance source …).

pen_origin.description: Pen-tool origin of a drawn path, in canvas pixels.

part_of.description: ID of the layer this decoration belongs to (irregular edges, labels …).

source_id.description: ID of the layer a scattered or repeated copy was made from.

recolor.description: Colour substitutions applied to a placed copy.

stroke_width.description: Stroke width in pixels (text: outline width).

shape.description: shape: rectangle, rounded-rectangle, capsule, ellipse, line, polygon, star, path or a catalog shape (arrow, speech bubble, heart …).

path.description: shape path: SVG path data (M L H V C S Q T A Z) in path_view coordinates.

path_view.description: shape path: [width, height] of the coordinate box path is written in.

radius.description: Corner radius in pixels (rounded rectangles; catalog shapes use it as a fraction).

sides.description: polygon and star: number of sides or points.

inner_radius.description: star: inner radius as a fraction of the outer.

start_angle.description: wedge and arc: start angle in degrees.

end_angle.description: wedge and arc: end angle in degrees.

trim_start.description: Stroke trim start, 0–1 of the outline length.

trim_end.description: Stroke trim end, 0–1 of the outline length.

line_cap.description: Stroke cap: butt, round or square.

line_join.description: Stroke join: miter, round or bevel.

stroke_align.description: Stroke position: center, inside or outside.

strokes.description: paint: brush strokes {brush, points, …}; shape: extra strokes drawn over the outline.

width_profile.description: Variable stroke width profile along the path.

marker_start.description: Marker at the path start (arrow, dot …).

marker_size.description: Marker size as a multiple of the stroke width.

distort.description: Envelope distortion of the geometry (arc, wave, perspective …).

vector_geometry.description: Cached outline geometry of a vector stroke.

irregular.description: Irregular (torn, rough) edge recipe and its source geometry.

die_cut.description: A die-cut outline record: the layers it surrounds and the offset distance.

reflection.description: A reflection layer's settings (horizon, sources), kept so it can be re-rendered.

export_fallback.description: Reason vector exports draw this layer as an image.

point_radius.description: Catalog shape: radius of star points.

valley_radius.description: Catalog shape: radius of star valleys.

rotation_offset.description: Catalog shape: rotation of the generated outline in degrees.

count.description: Catalog shape: number of repeated elements (rays, teeth, petals …).

depth.description: Catalog shape: depth; scene layers: depth for parallax and lighting.

pointer_position.description: Callout: pointer position along its side, 0–1.

pointer_side.description: Callout: side the pointer is on.

frame_shape.description: Frame shape of a framed catalog shape.

angle.description: gradient: angle in degrees for angled gradients; catalog shapes: an angle parameter.

seed.description: Random seed of a generated shape.

direction.description: gradient: horizontal, vertical, radial or angled.

center.description: Radial gradient centre as [x, y] fractions of the layer.

falloff.description: gradient: interpolation (linear, smooth, ease, quadratic, gaussian).

text.description: text: the plain text (also the text of rich text); ${variables} are substituted.

size.description: text and field: font size in pixels.

font.description: Font: a registered font name (state.fonts), a bundled font file name or a role.

font_role.description: Typography role the font follows (heading, body …).

align.description: Text alignment: left, center or right (fields too).

spacing.description: text: extra line spacing in pixels; catalog shapes: spacing parameter.

line_height.description: text: distance between baselines as a multiple of the size.

text_transform.description: text: none, uppercase, lowercase or capitalize, applied when drawing.

stage.description: text: type stage (display, h1 … caption) it was set with.

rich.description: Rich text: spans, paragraphs and their styles (see docs/rich-text.md).

literal_text.description: Intent: the text is literal (not copy to check or rewrite).

asset.description: raster and frame: the image member of the archive.

crop.description: Crop box [x0, y0, x1, y1] in source pixels (link and frame layers).

fit.description: How an image or linked document fills the box (fill, fit, stretch …).

position.description: Focus [x, y] fractions used when fit crops.

styles.description: Layer styles by name (drop-shadow, stroke, outer-glow, color-overlay, gradient-overlay), each with its settings and enabled.

looks.description: Applied looks (finishes) by name, listing the styles and effects each added.

appearance.description: field: widget appearance (style, fill, stroke, radius …).

mode.description: pathfinder: union, subtract, intersect, exclude, divide, minus-back, trim or merge.

operands.description: pathfinder: the layers it combines (embedded copies).

outline.description: pixel: generated outline: true, a colour or settings.

shading.description: pixel: generated shading: true or {light, colors, highlight}.

surface.description: paint: [width, height] of the surface strokes are recorded on.

field.description: field: the form field record {key, kind, label, options, required …}.

value.description: field: value drawn in a filled export (render copies only).

source.description: link: path of the linked document, relative to the document's folder.

source_page.description: link: page of the linked document to show.

source_hash.description: link: SHA-256 of the linked file when it was last placed or updated.

source_size.description: link: [width, height] of the linked page.

artboard.description: link: artboard of the linked document to show.

variables.description: link: variable values passed to the linked document.

corner_pin.description: link: four corner points for a perspective placement.

chart.description: group: the chart record (kind, data, options) its parts are drawn from.

chart_part.description: Which part of a chart this layer is.

table.description: group: the table record (rows, columns, styles).

table_part.description: Which part of a table this layer is.

kv_part.description: Which part of a key-value list this layer is.

code.description: shape: QR code or barcode record {kind, data …}.

drawing.description: A hand-drawing pipeline record (source, cleanup, vectorize settings).

drawing_role.description: Role of this layer in a drawing (line, fill …).

object.description: group: object declaration {kind, label, notes, references, version}.

object_part.description: This layer's part name {name, side} inside its object.

character_part.description: Which part of a character this layer is.

character_color.description: Character colour role of this part.

alt.description: Alternative text (exports carry it to SVG title, PDF /Alt and PPTX descr).

decorative.description: Accessibility: the layer is decoration (exports mark it as an artifact).

allow_overlap.description: IDs of layers this one may overlap without a check finding.

allow_crop.description: Intent: the canvas edge may crop the layer.

color_vision_safe.description: Intent: colour is not the only cue.

detached_ok.description: Intent: the layer may sit apart from the composition.

waive.description: Check findings waived on this layer.

background.description: Page background colour (else the canvas or master background).

hidden.description: Left out of exports unless named.

content.description: The page's own state (layers, active_layer, selection, timeline …) while another page is active; absent on the active page, whose content is at the top level.

page.description: One page of a multi-page document.

template.description: Template record of a document made from a template.

layers.description: Layers bottom to top (of the active page in a paged document).

active_layer.description: ID of the active layer, or null.

selection.description: The pixel selection mask (masks/<sha256>.png), or null.

timeline.description: Keyframe timeline: duration, fps, tracks, markers.

layout.description: The layout template applied and its slots.

comps.description: Layer comps: saved visibility and position states.

symbols.description: Symbol masters: name → master layer ID.

artboards.description: Artboards: name → {x, y, width, height, background, variables, targets}.

roles.description: Named layer roles bound for actions and recipes.

page_content.description: Page-scoped state of an inactive page or master: comic, template, audio_tracks, lighting, camera, particles, stop_motion, layers, active_layer, selection, timeline, blanks, layout, comps, symbols, artboards, roles, containers, animation, page_accessibility.

master.description: A master page drawn under the pages that name it.

content.description: The master's layers and scoped state.

effect.description: One effect of a stack: name, amount and its settings.

name.description: Effect name (blur, grain, lookup …; vixl_reference('operations') lists them).

selection.description: A selection mask member it is limited to.

id.description: Revision ID (the key it is stored under).

parent.description: Parent revision ID; null for the root.

operations.description: The operations this revision applied to its parent.

state.description: A full state snapshot (every 32nd revision on a chain, and the root).

delta.description: A delta from the parent's state (history.diff), instead of state.

squashed.description: Revisions folded into this one by history compaction.
